subject: Shiny server-pro evaluation- SSL dies on start up

messages.author: dcc898def586ebbd
messages.subject: Shiny server-pro evaluation- SSL dies on start up
parts:
Positive test:
1. Installed 45-day evaluation of shiny server pro.
2. sudo service shiny-server restart
3. Browse localhost:3838
Result: Browser displays sample apps page.

Failure:
1. Edit /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.confg to listen on port 443. 
2. Added ssl line with .pem and .cert to config file.
3. sudo service shiny-server restart.
Expected result: Shiny-server listenting on port 443 or error message in /var/log/shiny-server
Actual result: Process dies immediately. Nothing is written to /var/log/shiny-server

How do I debug this?
